recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast composition featuring three lines of centered, white sans-serif text against a dark, textured charcoal-to-black background. The layout is strictly symmetrical and emphasizes negative space and geometric letterforms.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical stack of three text blocks
Subtle grain texture across all elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Text is vertically centered, occupying the middle 60% of the frame with significant margins.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The middle line of text acts as the central pivot point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-to-bottom vertical scan following the three distinct blocks of text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds the text, creating a sense of isolation and focus.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal/black background with a fine noise texture.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white/light grey for the text to prevent harsh digital glare.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between foreground and background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used throughout for maximum cohesion.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric purity and circular 'O' shapes.
Provides the sharp geometric terminals and classic uppercase feel.
Offers a modern, clean, and authoritative sans-serif presence.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid black square background with a very fine, uniform monochromatic film grain or noise texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Typeset three lines of text in a geometric sans-serif font, all caps, center-aligned. Use wide tracking and generous vertical spacing between lines. Apply a slight transparency or subtle grain to the white text to blend it with the background texture.

verificationChecks: Is the font a geometric sans-serif?
Is there a visible fine grain texture?

mustRedesign: Exact kerning of the original artist name
postGenerationChecks: Check that all text is uppercase.
Verify the background is not a flat digital black but has texture.
Confirm the vertical spacing is balanced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Geometric Sans-Serif + Centered All-Caps + Wide Tracking + Grainy Black Background = Minimalist Iconic Cover
